applicant.name: Lena Moser
applicant.organisation: FitPath Digital Health GmbH, growth team

purpose: We will link the pseudonymised records with our app's user base through birth date, region and sex to find the users who have obesity, and show those users personalised weight-loss programme offers in the app.
question: Provide pseudonymised records of all adults with obesity.
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Obesity = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with E66.
Report per region: adults with obesity.
